usage: 「問題」 is a noun meaning a problem or issue.
It often comes after numbers or adjectives, like「數學問題」or「大問題」.
You can use「有問題」to mean something is wrong or there is a problem.
In questions,「問題」can also mean a question or thing to ask about.
